added: Added single-lesson transfer history on student enrollment cards.
Added guarded report regeneration for missing effective transferred lessons.
changed: Quick attendance now shows the current course and scrolls to the matching roster card.
Attendance colors now clearly distinguish present, absent, pending, and neutral states.
Single-lesson transfers can be chained or returned to a previous lesson while preserving report history.
fixed: Fixed missing transferred reports being omitted after deletion or incomplete creation.
Fixed transfer history and effective-target RPC column ambiguity errors.
tests: Added regression coverage for transfer chains, report recovery, transfer history, attendance colors, roster scrolling, and release metadata.
deployment: Apply 1000034_repair_effective_single_lesson_transfer_reports.sql after the existing transfer migrations.
Rebuild and redeploy the frontend with version 1.7.4.

added: Added single-lesson transfer report conflict management with per-field source/target selection and safe cancellation.
Added human-readable transfer conflict details with collapsible technical IDs.
changed: Effective lesson rosters now prevent report recreation in the source lesson after a transfer.
Existing reports move with a transfer and retain their content.
tests: Added coverage for transfer rosters, report migration, idempotency, conflict resolution, readable formatting, and release metadata.
deployment: Apply migrations 1000030 and 1000031 in order before deploying the frontend.
Existing reports are not automatically cleaned up.

fixed: The DHI Nginx image now explicitly runs the EduLog bootstrap, writes the active Nginx configuration, and listens on the exposed application ports.
Built frontend files now belong to the non-root Nginx user so runtime-config.js can be regenerated without elevated container privileges.
tests: Added Docker startup contract coverage and verified health, homepage, runtime configuration, and generated JavaScript assets return HTTP 200 from a live container.
deployment: No database migration or Edge Function deployment is required.
Rebuild and redeploy the application Docker image.

fixed: Dashboard and incomplete-report tasks now require assignment, explicit teacher attendance, and an effective class-role notification policy; absence and deny decisions take precedence.
Policy-aware incomplete-report queries now fail closed instead of exposing the broader attended-teacher scope.

Notification eligibility now requires an effective class teacher assignment on the occurrence date; generic RBAC assignments cannot replace a class role, and classes with no eligible role or policy notify nobody.
Policy-aware notification responses now bypass client caches, use private no-store response headers, and clear stale incomplete-report data when the endpoint fails.
Automatic class report creation now includes regular enrollments only.
A persisted present and fully completed report on the highest-sequence lesson now completes a regular enrollment without chapter or progress-letter checks.
Classroom actions remain visible on touch devices; student profiles, report calendars, and wrapped class schedules now stay within narrow layouts.
RBAC compatibility views now use invoker security, the role trigger has a fixed search path, and duplicate legacy indexes were removed.
The container release workflow now runs tests, production type-checking, and the application build before publishing.
tests: Added regression coverage for yuan's 2026-07-25 assistant deny, effective-date notification eligibility, no-policy fail-closed behavior, no-store responses, regular-only report creation, final-lesson completion, responsive layouts, calendar synchronization, and database lint fixes.
deployment: Deploy the updated aggregate-incomplete-reports Edge Function after 1000029, then deploy the frontend.

added: Added extensible roles and system, classroom, and class notification policies with inherit, notify, and do-not-notify states.
Added responsive room management with child-class search, inline notification settings, and reuse of the full class editor.
Added responsive quick attendance, roster filtering, student workflow improvements, and a shared accessible globe language menu.
changed: Incomplete report pages and dashboard tasks now only show students from classes where the current assigned teacher was explicitly marked present.
Class occurrence loading now initializes immediately and navigates actual previous and next occurrences.
Internal links use native same-tab navigation while external links retain safe new-tab behavior.
Improved responsive class headers, room cards, student rosters, report split views, and management panels.
fixed: Separated notification eligibility from report visibility so policies never expose another teacher’s reports.
Made room and class retries reuse entities created before a dependent policy, teacher, or occurrence write failed.
Removed unreadable narrow quick-attendance columns and metadata overflow.
tests: Added coverage for attended-teacher visibility, scoped policy inheritance and deny precedence, room/class policy workflows, retry safety, language accessibility, responsive layouts, and navigation contracts.
deployment: Deploy the updated aggregate-incomplete-reports Edge Function.

added: Added weekly multi-day, monthly day-of-month, and exact-date camp schedules with per-day class times.
Added draft camps with editable ranges and safe future-occurrence reconciliation.
Added versioned rich-text documents, collaborative snapshot recovery, editor appearance settings, and reusable read-only rendering.
Added frontend and self-hosted Supabase environment templates.
changed: Unified enrollment, trial activation, transfer, make-up, and class displays around the new schedule rules.
Made classroom selection optional during enrollment and automatically filled it from the selected class session.
fixed: Filtered enrollment and transfer class options so only classes capable of teaching the selected course are shown.
Backfilled and continuously synchronized enrollment classroom references with their class sessions.
Made the classroom session filter searchable.
Improved rich-text placeholder positioning, localization, queued auto-save, parent-state synchronization, and stale snapshot protection.
tests: Added coverage for recurring and camp schedules, occurrence reconciliation, editor save behavior, session eligibility, and classroom synchronization.

fixed: Added classroom filtering to the student enrollment modal.
Expanded student enrollment class session options to show weekday and time range.

added: Added an external report overview URL field to the new student enrollment modal.
fixed: Constrained the student enrollment modal height so its form content scrolls correctly on smaller devices.
Corrected the PWA manifest app name to display as EduLog.

added: Global incomplete report dashboard with filtering and attendance scoping.
SessionDetailsView and supporting report services for classroom management.
Holiday management view with tabbed closure and teacher leave tracking.
AggregateService for API data aggregation and environment-based runtime configuration with Docker support.
Automated report version snapshots.
robots.txt file to allow web crawlers.

tests: Added unit tests for HolidayCommandService and HolidayQueryService.

added: Student management module with profiles, contacts, school history, and course enrollment workflows.
Native HTTPS support for the EduLog frontend with externally mounted certificate and key files.
External GitHub changelog link from the in-app changelog view.
changed: Updated frontend proxy and security header deployment settings for Caddy, Nginx, and HTTPS upstream scenarios.
Expanded environment examples for frontend hostname, HTTPS, SSL, HSTS, and CSP settings.
fixed: Ensured holiday updates and deletions release class occurrence locks and student attendance states after holiday ranges change.
Fixed aggregate classroom session manager visible and hidden filtering errors that could return 500 responses.
Added HSTS and CSP headers for the EduLog frontend while keeping the default CSP free of unsafe-eval.
tests: Added coverage for aggregate classroom session manager edge function behavior, holiday sync/release logic, and Vite security helpers.
